title: BRO Geomorphological Map — Area of geomorphological interest
description:
40,840 polygons delimiting the area of geomorphological interest of the national Geomorphological Map 1:50,000 (GMM). Produced under VRO; bronhouder Wageningen Environmental Research.

🤖 AI/Agent users: see AGENTS.md for field descriptions, query examples and usage tips.

BRO Geomorphological Map — Area of geomorphological interest documentation

table:columns.name: identification
table:columns.description: Unique ID of the map polygon (Kaartvlak identificatie) of this area of geomorphological interest (GMM cat. 4.3.3.1).

table:columns.name: collection_id
table:columns.description: ID of the geomorphological area collection (vlakcollectie) this polygon belongs to (GMM cat. 4.3.2.1).

table:columns.name: type
table:columns.description: Type of geomorphological interest (geomorfologisch belang): Dijk or Water; features relevant to landform formation, without a landform description (GMM cat. 4.3.4).

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Feature geometry (WKB) in EPSG:28992 (Amersfoort / RD New).

table:columns.name: geom_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float, ymin: float, xmax: float, ymax: float>
table:columns.description: Per-feature bounding box struct for spatial filtering.
